title: Ferdinand of Bavaria, Elector of Cologne, to Duke Maximilian I of Bavaria, Bonn, 22 December 1619

documents.shelfmark: BayHStA, Kurbayern Äußeres Archiv 4591, ff. 281-286 (DECODE R9426)

plaintext.source: no decipherment with the letter; DECODE status 'Non-decrypted'; no printed edition found

transcription.source: DECODE images IMG_R9426_I44572_P1..P11 (login only, not public domain)
transcription.notes: docs/_check_profile.py --measure over transcription.txt gives 3932 tokens / 634 distinct, which counts the bracketed clear words and the two word-end separator signs as tokens; the profile uses count.py's figure of 2614 enciphered tokens (2519 letter tokens, 95 nomenclator tokens), which is the unit the read bar is measured in. Image 7 duplicates image 6 (same page photographed twice), so the ten pages are on eleven images.

documents.shelfmark: BayHStA, Kurbayern Äußeres Archiv 4591, ff. 278-280 (DECODE R9425)
documents.route: Brussels -> Munich (resolution handed to the League agent Morreus)

plaintext.source: red marginal abstract by a contemporary decipherer (summary, not group by group); one gloss 'Ambr.' beside code 2; DECODE status 'Decrypted'

transcription.source: DECODE images IMG_R9425_I44571_P1..P6 (login only, not public domain)
transcription.notes: r9425/count_r9425.py gives 1567 enciphered tokens (1482 letter tokens, 85 nomenclator tokens); docs/_check_profile.py --measure counts clear words and separators too (413 distinct). Clear passages transcribed as a working reading only. 'distinct' = distinct cipher tokens (letter values plus code groups), measured over the parsed words.

system.summary: Homophonic substitution on even two-digit figures 10-78 with two word-end separator signs, plus a three-digit nomenclator.

prior_solution.where: DECODE R9426 'Non-decrypted'; not in Briefe und Akten NF I/1 (Franz 1966), Hurter viii, Wolf/Breyer iv or Pastor; 'Kurbayern Aeusseres Archiv 4591' cited nowhere

conditions.human_role: supplied the DECODE account whose cookie fetched the images in an earlier session; nothing else
tools: simulated annealing over a homophonic key (solve.py)

solution.what: DECODE record page and the eleven images, already in the untracked targets/kaa4591/img/ work folder from the catalogue-161 session

agent sweep of Briefe und Akten zur Geschichte des Dreissigjaehrigen Krieges NF I/1 (Franz 1966), Hurter viii, Wolf/Breyer iv, Pastor, Google Books and archive.org for a printed text or decipherment of either 1619 letter
ten pages read line by line into transcription.txt, clear passages bracketed; pages 3-10 photographed upside down and rotated first
symbol inventory: 34 even two-digit values carry the letters, three-digit and odd two-digit groups stand apart, two signs recur at every word end
homophonic substitution with vowel homophones and a separate nomenclator, German plaintext
six annealing restarts over pages 1-3 (932 letters) against lang de-1500s
ten restarts over all ten pages (2482 letters); the key table settled and the text read as German
decode.py flagged every word the model dislikes; about sixty single-token transcription slips corrected (digit pairs 0/6, 3/5, 1/4, 2/7, 5/8), a sample re-checked on the images at full zoom
the key applied unchanged to the sibling record R9425 (ff. 278-280, same correspondence): its first cipher line reads 'lbrecht von Gottes Gnaden'
KAA 4591's own key records searched for the 1619 cipher: R9419 (f. 267) is a Latin 1-99 nomenclator, R9420-R9423 are 1530s-1583 alphabets
R9425's red marginal notes enhanced by channel separation and contrast, hoping for a group-by-group decipherment of the nomenclator; the margin is an abstract of the letter, not a decipherment

sender, recipient, place and date established from the clear last page ('meiner Statt Bonn den 22. Decembris Anno 1619', signed Ferdinand) and from the ciphered 'mein Thumbcapitel', 'meine Landtstendt', Paderborn

P8.15-P8.20 re-read on the image to fill the quotation cut for Lasry's list: the clear words are 'Ich vermeine, das die' (not 'Ich hoffe'), and the cut words are 'unser [248=und] in kurzer Zeit unser'; the passage reads continuously. Transcription, reading, reveal and page corrected; key unchanged.
R9425 images P1-P6 already in targets/kaa4591/img/; page order of the letter established as P1 (f.278r), P2 (278v), P6 (279r), P3 (279v), P4 (280r clear close), P5 (endorsement)
R9425's four cipher pages read strip by strip at full resolution into r9425/transcription.txt (about 100 manuscript lines), clear passages bracketed

R9426 key applied unchanged to all of R9425 (r9425/decode_r9425.py): the letters read as German throughout ('Recuperation und Wiedereroberung', 'aintausendt Curissier', 'Lützenburg', 'Brisach', 'Onnate', 'catolischen Liga')

words the decrypt left odd re-read on zoom: 'correspondentr' -> 58 (correspondentz), 'erssens' -> overwritten 52 (erstens), 'geureme' -> 30 18 52 48 72 78 18 (getrewe); several line-end signs taken for hyphens were word ends
414 as a person or title (R9426's reading): contradicted by 'Kön. 414 M. und L.' beside 'Kön. 165 und L.' and by 'unsers 414 hochlöblichen'

414, 415, 416, 417, 419 fixed as nulls from the parallel formulas 'iren L. 414 L.' / 'ire L. 415 L.' and 'zu gedachtem 419 End'; 242 = und and 165 = Mt. from 'Kön. M. 417 242 415 L.' and 'Kön. 165 und L.'; 2 = Ambrosio from the red margin gloss 'Ambr.'

the open groups retried against both letters: 41 = Chur-, 218 = Rath, 169 = Kriegs-, 216 = Pferd, 154 = Haus, 47 = Mt., 31 = Vettern, 157 = Hilf supported by one or two contexts each, kept as probable and not counted; 45, 149, 225, 160, 219, 153, 15, 215, 155, 221, 136, 140, 249 stay open
r9425/count_r9425.py: 1524 of 1567 tokens read = 97.3% (1500 of 1543 = 97.2% without nulls); lm.best_language puts the decrypt in German first

sender, date and occasion from the clear close (15 Dec 1619) and the endorsement 'Resolutio deß hertzogs Albrechts dem L. Morreo … ertailt': Archduke Albert's answer to the League agent Licentiate Morreus
feedback to R9426: with 414-419 null, 23 of its 74 open nomenclator tokens become nulls (95.8% -> 96.7%) and 232 = stift is nearly forced; noted in NOTES, not yet applied to R9426's count or the site

Statistical validation (docs/_validate.py): 3942 tokens, 43 types, de-1640s order 4: reading -2.051 per letter; random keys -5.831 (z 7.3); key annealed onto shuffled ciphertext best -3.686 (mean -3.718, z 74.5); annealer on the real text -3.353. Verdict: pass.

validation.notes: claimed per-occurrence score -2.051; polyphony 0.0; 239 unread tokens left out; annealer on the real text from random keys reached -3.353

outcome.method_basis: The homophonic key was annealed against the de-1500s German model from the letter alone (DECODE R9426, no prior reading found in Briefe und Akten NF I/1, Hurter, Wolf/Breyer or Pastor) and checked by applying it unchanged to sibling R9425.
outcome.fraction_read_source: count.py over transcription.txt: enciphered tokens; letters in words that do not read as German counted unread, nomenclator groups without an established value counted unread
outcome.notes: Letters: 2483 of 2519 read. Nomenclator: only 248 = 'und' is established, from its own contexts. Four words (37 tokens) still do not read and three read as proper names whose bearers are not identified. R9425 (Albert's resolution of 15 Dec 1619, ff. 278-280) read 2 Oct 2026 with the key unchanged: 97.3% measured (r9425/count_r9425.py); it fixes 414/415/416/417/419 as nulls, 242 = und, 165 = Mt., 2 = Ambrosio. outcome.fraction_read still gives R9426's figure.
